# Natura Bliss (Full Documentation)

> Comprehensive Product Catalog, Extraction Details, Policies & Agentic Guides for Natura Bliss Pakistan.

Natura Bliss is an authentic Pakistani organic wellness and beauty brand headquartered in Chakwal, Punjab. The brand specializes in traditional cold-pressing extraction of seed and nut oils, artisan herbal soaps, sulphate-free shampoos, and natural brightening skincare.

## Primary Navigation

- [Home](https://naturabliss.pk/): Main landing page with featured products, seasonal promotions, and reviews.
- [Collection](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Complete catalog of cold-pressed oils, hair treatments, handmade soaps, and skincare products.
- [About Us](https://naturabliss.pk/about): Background on cold-press extraction, zero chemical additives, and farm origins in Chakwal.
- [Contact](https://naturabliss.pk/contact): Customer service, phone numbers, email support, and store inquiry forms.
- [Blog](https://naturabliss.pk/blog): Educational articles on organic skincare, hair growth routines, and oil benefits.

## Pure Cold-Pressed Oils

All Natura Bliss oils are extracted using traditional cold-pressing methods without heat, hexane, mineral oil, or synthetic preservatives.

- [Coconut Oil](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): 100% extra-virgin cold-pressed coconut oil for deep scalp nourishment and body hydration.
- [Sweet Almond Oil](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Rich in Vitamin E, ideal for dark circles, skin brightening, and strengthening hair follicles.
- [Castor Oil](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Thick, nutrient-dense oil for stimulating eyebrow, eyelash, and scalp hair density.
- [Blackseed (Kalonji) Oil](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Traditional therapeutic oil renowned for scalp health and holistic vitality.
- [Sesame Oil](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Deeply penetrating massage and hair treatment oil packed with antioxidants.
- [Pumpkin Seed Oil](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Natural DHT-blocker promoting healthy hair follicles and scalp balance.
- [Onion Seed Oil](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Rich in sulfur, specifically formulated to reduce excessive hair fall and stimulate roots.
- [Rosemary Essential Infused Oil](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Invigorating botanical oil that enhances scalp microcirculation for faster hair regrowth.
- [Pure Olive Oil](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Extra-virgin unrefined olive oil for skin barrier restoration and conditioning.

## Herbal Haircare Line

- [Herbal Shampoo](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Natural botanical cleanser infused with Shikakai, Amla, and Reetha. Free of sulfates and parabens.
- [Kre-Bio Shampoo & Conditioner](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Anti-breakage therapy restoring keratin balance and moisture to dry, damaged hair.
- [Onion Hair Growth Oil & 804 Serum](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Intensive hair regrowth remedies targeting thinning spots, dandruff, and split ends.

## Organic Handmade Soaps

- [Neem Clarifying Soap](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Antibacterial cold-process bar soothing active acne and breakouts.
- [Rice Brightening Soap](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Gentle exfoliating bar targeting hyperpigmentation, tanning, and uneven tone.
- [Activated Charcoal Soap](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Deep pore cleanser detoxifying dirt, sebum, and pollutants from oily skin.

## Gluta Radiance Skincare

- [Gluta Fair Night Cream](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Gentle botanical glow night treatment reducing blemishes and restoring radiance.
- [Gluta Care Body Lotion](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Daily nourishing body moisturizer preserving natural hydration barriers.
- [Gluta Facial Wash](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Non-stripping facial cleanser gently purifying impurities and dull skin.
- [No Frac Night Cream](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Intensive evening formulation targeting fine lines and dry patches.

## Farm-Fresh Organic Nutrition

- [Pure Pakistani Desi Ghee](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Traditional grass-fed clarified butter prepared using authentic churning methods.
- [Wild Forest Raw Honey](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): 100% pure unfiltered, unpasteurized natural honey collected from wild forest bee hives.

## Commercial Terms & Logistics

- **Payment Methods:** Cash on Delivery (COD), Direct Bank Transfer, EasyPaisa, and JazzCash.
- **Shipping Coverage:** Nationwide delivery across Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Sialkot, Gujranwala, Quetta, and all rural districts.
- **Transit Time:** 2 to 4 business days.
- **Return Window:** 7 days for exchange or refund on defective or broken merchandise.
